title: Jev 1.14 — chunks, maximum P(A)
purpose: Test whether judging smaller pieces helps detection, using the strongest local signal.
method: Use the baseline chunk planner (12,000-token budget, single-pass-if-fits shortcut). Classify each chunk with A–D options and a partial-transcript notice. Take the maximum raw P(A) and flag at ≥ 0.5.
notes: All 2,834 chunk calls completed: 184 Actions, 1,256 CoT and 1,394 Combined.
Maximum and average reuse the same calls; averaging is not weighted by chunk length.
This is a binary threshold rule, not choosing the largest of A, B, C and D. Any missing chunk invalidates the case.
Chunking and the final decision rule both differ from full-input highest-answer inference.
Shared chunk job duration: 1:02:10 through the hosted API.
